firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went on a journey starts and takes the travel journal and knowledge-disk bag.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This player also begins the optional setup card exchange and cargo-tile draw. Turns proceed clockwise.
